correctness.rationale: Diagonal colour translation annihilates unbalanced characters. For balanced k, differences d_i=x_{i+1}-x_i in {±1} with sum d_i=0, together with x_1, bijectively encode proper colourings. The 3-term roots-of-unity filter cancels the choice of initial colour and gives three products of local factors 2 or -1, hence (-1)^n sum(-2)^c_r. The b_n=0 distinguished suffix coordinate makes histogram multiplicity (n-1)!/((c0-1)! c1! c2!). Sorting three exponents proves the only cancellation is {a,a,a+1} with a>=1; its three placements give Z_n=(3a+1)!/((a+1)!a!²). The finite abelian Fourier basis gives rank 3^(n-1)-Z_n. Stirling yields 9sqrt(3)/(2pi n) balanced null fraction for n=3a+1. Independently recomputed exact small ranks n=3,4,5,6 and inspected both differently structured exact finite scripts through n=7, not treating enumeration as the all-n proof.
